_schema.purpose: Override registry for the heading-case Title-Case sensor (book-models/lint_heading_case.py). A heading whose CLEANED text (section number + {anchor} stripped) exactly matches an 'overrides[].heading' value is never flagged, even if the algorithm would suggest a different casing. Seed only with GENUINELY intentional exceptions the stop-word/proper-noun rule cannot express.

overrides.heading: self-communicate
overrides.reason: Bare skill-package identifier used as a section heading in the skill-recipe appendix. The package is a lowercase code identifier (referenced lowercase in body prose and the `terms:` metadata tags); preserve the authored identifier casing rather than title-case a code name.

overrides.heading: self-governance
overrides.reason: Bare skill-package identifier used as a section heading; lowercase code identifier per body prose and `terms:` tags — preserve authored casing.

overrides.heading: self-operate
overrides.reason: Bare skill-package identifier used as a section heading; lowercase code identifier per body prose and `terms:` tags — preserve authored casing.

overrides.heading: The Canonical Move: From Observability to Provenance
overrides.reason: Chicago capitalizes the first word of a subtitle after a colon regardless of part of speech; 'From' is the subtitle-initial word, which the stop-word rule cannot express.

overrides.heading: III. A New Class of Input
overrides.reason: Roman-numeral section heading in Chapter 4 (Engineering Through Models). 'A' is the FIRST content word of the title ('A New Class of Input') and is correctly capitalized; the Title-Case sensor does not treat the leading Roman-numeral marker as a section prefix, so it mis-lowercases the article that opens the title.

overrides.heading: VII. The Resulting Model Family
overrides.reason: Roman-numeral section heading in Chapter 4 (Engineering Through Models). 'The' is the FIRST content word of the title ('The Resulting Model Family') and is correctly capitalized; the sensor mis-lowercases it because the leading Roman-numeral marker is not recognized as a section prefix.
